text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! My bangs just look
so limp and flat today.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf is usually more, you know...
all sharp and dignified.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hold out a little longer!
I'll show them I can make a crescent moon
as cool as the President's!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, it's already this late?!
I'm gonna miss the breakfast rush?!
My chicken nanban!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was crestfallen after missing out on the meal she had her eye on.
